description: Ministry of Housing & Constructions - Condominium Management Authority Law, No. 11 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Condominium Management Authority Law, establishing fees for various condominium-related services. It constitutes subsidiary legislation that modifies the legal/regulatory framework, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) which includes "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
